backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use exp-20260510-028 augmented Space snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260512-008 policy semantics.
decision_rationale: Near-perfect TQS did not identify a robust Space breakout risk allocation edge on top of the accepted exp-20260512-008 Space stack. Do not add a separate high-TQS breakout scalar on the frozen Space snapshots; breakout alpha needs forward catalyst-quality evidence or a different ex-ante discriminator.

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies built from a 2026-05-10 research universe; any accepted change must remain default-off metadata until forward evidence matures.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: adjust only official Space breakout_long candidates with 0.95 <= existing trade_quality_score < 1.0.

2_history_check.exp-20260511-019: Accepted PL/BKSY data-vendor breakout 0.1x haircut; this keeps that ticker-bucket rule fixed and tests a TQS bucket.
2_history_check.exp-20260511-022: Rejected non-data-vendor breakout haircut; this tests quality-conditioned breakout exposure, not all remaining breakouts.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-008: Accepted near-perfect Space trend TQS 1.10x risk; this tests the same TQS band but the breakout lifecycle only.
2_history_check.exp-20260512-009: Rejected peer-momentum leader top-up; this does not use peer momentum and does not add risk broadly.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: space_near_perfect_tqs_breakout_risk_scalar; candidate pool, accepted Space risk scalars, targets, stops, ranking, add-ons, LLM/news, and live slots stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least 2/3 improved EV windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, and nonzero adjusted signals.
gate_questions.5_reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-20260512-008 Space stack, and each near-perfect breakout TQS scalar across the canonical augmented snapshots.

hypothesis: After near-perfect TQS trend signals earned a small risk top-up, the remaining Space breakout fragility may be concentrated in high-but-uncapped TQS breakouts. A bounded breakout-specific scalar could reduce false quality confidence without changing entries, ranking, targets, stops, or the Space candidate pool.
interpretation: Near-perfect TQS did not identify a robust Space breakout risk allocation edge on top of the accepted exp-20260512-008 Space stack. Do not add a separate high-TQS breakout scalar on the frozen Space snapshots; breakout alpha needs forward catalyst-quality evidence or a different ex-ante discriminator.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data remains below the closed-decision gate; this run uses the existing deterministic trade-quality score.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby near-perfect Space breakout TQS scalars on the same frozen snapshots. Future Space breakout work should use forward event replacement value or a genuinely new catalyst-quality field.
